tagline.en: Streaming 3D reconstruction that builds scene geometry from a video as frames arrive.
tagline.zh: 流式 3D 重建,随视频帧到达即时构建场景几何。

en: Infinite VGGT (StreamVGGT) is a 3D reconstruction model that works in a streaming fashion: instead of waiting for a full image set, it ingests frames as they come in and incrementally recovers the scene's 3D structure. It builds on the VGGT line of feed-forward geometry models.
This makes it a fit for long or open-ended video, where reconstructing everything at once is impractical. WorldFoundry vendors the StreamVGGT pipeline in-tree for streaming reconstruction.
In WorldFoundry you feed it a sequence of frames and it produces the reconstructed 3D geometry. Checkpoint-backed inference needs the StreamVGGT weights staged first.
zh: Infinite VGGT(StreamVGGT)是一个以流式方式工作的 3D 重建模型:它不必等待完整的图像集,而是随帧到达逐步摄入,并增量地恢复场景的 3D 结构。它构建在 VGGT 系列前馈几何模型之上。
这让它适合处理长视频或开放式视频——对这类输入,一次性重建全部内容并不现实。WorldFoundry 将 StreamVGGT pipeline 内置在项目中用于流式重建。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把一段帧序列交给它,它便输出重建的 3D 几何。基于 checkpoint 的推理需要先备好 StreamVGGT 权重。

whenToUse.en: Use it for 3D reconstruction from video where frames arrive over time — long or continuous sequences that you'd rather process incrementally than all at once.
whenToUse.zh: 当你要从随时间到达的视频帧做 3D 重建——面对长序列或连续序列、更希望增量处理而非一次性处理时,选它。

notFor.en: It reconstructs geometry, it does not generate new imagery. The model weights are downloaded separately, so stage them before running.
notFor.zh: 它重建几何,而不生成新图像。模型权重需单独下载,请在运行前先备好。

en: Handles long or open-ended video sequences
Builds on the VGGT feed-forward geometry approach
zh: 可处理长视频或开放式视频序列
